# Van Gogh Alive – Genoa

> A world-leading immersive multi-sensory art experience featuring Van Gogh's works through cutting-edge SENSORY4 projection technology in Genoa, Italy.

Van Gogh Alive is an innovative exhibition that combines immersive technology with art education, offering visitors an interactive experience of Vincent van Gogh's masterpieces. The site also provides extensive educational resources on painting techniques, art history, and color theory for artists of all skill levels.

## Exhibition Experience

- [Van Gogh Alive – Genoa](https://www.vangoghgenova.it): Homepage for Van Gogh Alive, world's most visited multi-sensory art experience in Genoa
- [The Experience](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/experience.html): Core product page describing the immersive Van Gogh Alive exhibition experience
- [Sensory 4](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/sensory-4.html): SENSORY4 technology system powering Van Gogh Alive's projection and surround sound
- [Location](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/location.html): Exhibition location details for Van Gogh Alive at Porto Antico, Genoa
- [Video](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/video.html): Video gallery showcasing Van Gogh Alive exhibition experience

## Painting Techniques & Tutorials

- [How to Clean an Acrylic or Oil Paint Palette](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/acrylic-painting-tips-cleaning-a-palette.html): Tutorial on cleaning and maintaining acrylic and oil paint palettes
- [DIY Paint Color Mixing Charts](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/color-mixing-charts.html): Guide to creating DIY color mixing charts for acrylic and watercolor painting
- [How to Draw Animal Fur: Quick & Easy Tips](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/cuteness-alert-heres-the-secret-to-drawing-animal-fur-that-looks-totally-real.html): Tutorial on drawing realistic animal fur with pencil shading techniques
- [Unusual Painting Techniques](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/unusual-painting-techniques.html): Guide to unconventional painting techniques including abstract expressionism methods
- [How to Make a Monotype Print or Monoprints](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/how-to-make-a-monotype-print.html): Step-by-step tutorial on monotype printmaking technique and materials
- [How to Improve Your Painting Compositions](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/painting-composition-examples.html): Guide to composition techniques using examples from Giorgio Morandi
- [Painting a Diptych](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/painting-a-diptych.html): Guide to painting diptych format with historical art examples
- [How to Paint Ripples in the Ocean](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/painting-ripples-in-the-ocean.html): Beginner watercolor tutorial on painting ocean water ripples and patterns

## Art History & Movements

- [7 Major Painting Styles, From Realism to Abstract](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/art-styles-explained-realism-to-abstract.html): Educational guide covering seven major painting styles and art movements
- [Techniques and Palettes of the Pre-Raphaelites Painters](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/pre-raphaelite-painters-palettes-and-techniques.html): Reference on Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood painting techniques and color palettes
- [An In-Depth Look at 'Christina's World' by Andrew Wyeth](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/christinas-world-by-andrew-wyeth.html): In-depth analysis of Andrew Wyeth's Christina's World painting and technique
- [Biography of Sonia Delaunay, Modernist Designer](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/sonia-delaunay-biography.html): Biography of modernist pioneer Sonia Delaunay and her artistic innovations

## Color Theory & Reference

- [Color Palettes of Famous Paintings](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/color-palettes-of-famous-paintings.html): Reference on color palettes from famous paintings by master artists
- [Art Glossary: Primary Colors](https://www.vangoghgenova.it/definition-of-primary-colors.html): Reference entry on primary colors, pigments, and color theory fundamentals
